nodes.label: ADR 0008: Tenant Connect Onboarding via Embedded Components on Web
nodes.rationale: Use embedded <ConnectAccountOnboarding> component on web for tenant Stripe Connect KYC/onboarding in v1. Tenants stay on Avantej domain. Server endpoints: connect.getOrCreateAccount (idempotent Express account creation), connect.createAccountSession (returns client_secret for component), connect.dashboardLink (fallback). Organizations table gains stripeConnectStatus, chargesEnabled, payoutsEnabled, detailsSubmitted columns synced via account.updated webhook.
alternatives_rejected: Hosted account link redirect (breaks brand presence)
Custom UI on Accounts API (high maintenance)
